result.rationale: The diff replaces the local permalink-topic creation in disqus.thor with `post = TopicEmbed.import_remote(user, t[:link], title: t[:title])`, and TopicEmbed.import_remote in this diff does `open(url).read` — a network fetch. The threads loop has no begin/rescue, so an unreachable link (OpenURI::HTTPError, SocketError, timeout) raises and aborts the whole import run, whereas the removed code built topics purely from the exported data. The mechanism described matches the diff exactly; this is a behavior regression of the import task triggered by dead links.

judged_text: disqus:import now fetches each thread's link over the network via TopicEmbed.import_remote (open(url).read) instead of building the topic entirely from the export file. Any dead link, timeout, or non-HTML response raises inside the threads loop and aborts the remaining import mid-run, where the previous implementation created the permalink topic locally with no HTTP dependency — a large historical import now fails wholesale on the first unreachable URL.
